definitions.explanation: The act of translating into English, or the resulting translated text.

examples.japanese: この{文|ぶん}を{英訳|えいやく}してください。
examples.english: Please translate this sentence into English.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{小説|しょうせつ}の{英訳|えいやく}が{出版|しゅっぱん}された。
examples.english: An English translation of a Japanese novel was published.

examples.japanese: {専門|せんもん}{用語|ようご}を{英訳|えいやく}するのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Translating technical terminology into English is difficult.

notes:
RELATED TRANSLATION TERMS:
- {和訳|わやく}: Japanese translation (translating into Japanese)
- {翻訳|ほんやく}: translation (general term, any language pair)
- {通訳|つうやく}: interpretation (spoken translation)
- {直訳|ちょくやく}: literal translation
- {意訳|いやく}: free/liberal translation

USAGE NOTES:
{英訳|えいやく} specifically means translating into English. It can be used as a noun ({英訳|えいやく}を{読|よ}む, to read the English translation) or as a verb with する ({英訳|えいやく}する, to translate into English).
